chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whoever washes his hand before food and after it will live in ease and will be kept safe from affliction in his body.

key_terms.سَعَةٍ: ease, spaciousness, and comfort in living

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام say about washing the hands before and after eating?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the etiquette of washing the hand before and after eating. It presents this practice as a cause of ease in life and protection from bodily affliction.
